'''Argent Sky Lancers''' were class-nine orbital laser satellites, designed to fire on the ships approaching the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] took control over the satellites and flipped them to fire down on the surface of the planet.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]]|Retribution from Above|[[Makeb]]}}</ref>
